names.name: Fastnacht Day
names.said: In Lancaster County, Tuesday has a different name.

text.what: Shrove Tuesday in Pennsylvania Dutch country, named after the donut rather than the fast.
text.story: Fasnachts were made to empty the pantry of lard, sugar, fat and butter before Lent. Lancaster, York, Lebanon and Berks counties keep the day; most chain supermarkets in eastern Pennsylvania carry the donuts for it. Parts of Maryland call them kinklings or kuechles and bakeries there sell them only on that Tuesday.
text.today: Churches and fire halls take orders by the dozen and stop when the batch is gone.

kin.as: The Polish observance on the same day.

geo.note: the town the day is most associated with, not a venue
